content.hebrew: אֵלִי, שִׁמְעֲךָ שָׁמְעוּ רְחוֹקִים, וְרָגְזוּ וְחָלוּ,
content.transliteration: Eli, shim‘akha shame‘u reḥoḳim, veraḡezu veḥalu,
content.english: My God, distant [individuals] heard about Your fame, and trembled and quaked,
content.comments: Distant [individuals]. Although this is in the plural, it refers here specifically to Jethro.

content.hebrew: הִתְלוֹנֵן בְּצִלְּךָ – וְאֶל טוּבְךָ יִשְׁאָלוּ.
content.english: [Wanting] to dwell in Your shade—and they asked for Your goodness.

content.hebrew: רְצוֹנְךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת שָׂמְחוּ וַיִּצְהָלוּ.
content.english: To do Your will they rejoiced and were glad.

content.hebrew: נְדָבוֹת וְשַׁי יוֹבִֽילוּ.
content.english: They brought donations and gifts.

content.hebrew: שָׂשִׂים וְגַם שְׂמֵחִים, פְּנֵי אֵל יְחַלּוּ.
content.transliteration: Sasim veḡam semeḥim, penē el yeḥallu.
content.english: Being happy and joyous, they beseeched God.

content.hebrew: בְּעֹז מַתַּת דָּת יָגִֽילוּ.
content.english: They rejoiced in the might of the giving of the Law.

content.hebrew: מַה נַּעֲלָה חֹֽדֶשׁ שְׁלִישִׁי, בּוֹ אָהָֽלוּ
content.transliteration: Ma na‘ala ḥodesh shelishi, bo ahalu
content.english: How exalted is the third month, in which at Mount Sinai they—

content.hebrew: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר סִינָי, וּבְשֵׁם אֱלֹהִים דָּגָֽלוּ.
content.transliteration: Yisra’el behar Sinay, uvshem Elohim daḡlu.
content.english: Israel—pitched tents, and hoisted their banner in God’s name.

content.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה עָלָה [אֶל] הָאֱלֹהִים, וְקָרָא אֶל הַשָּׁמַֽיִם, וְנָגֹֽלּוּ;
content.transliteration: UMoshe ‘ala el ha’Elohim, veḳara el hash’shamayim, venaḡollu;
content.english: Moses ascended to God, and He called to the heavens, and they were rolled up;

content.hebrew: וַעֲנָנֵי הַכָּבוֹד אֹתוֹ עַל כַּפַּֽיִם קִבֵּֽלוּ.
content.english: And the Clouds of Glory accepted [Moses] with open arms.

content.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָיו יוי: "בָּנַי בְּרַעְיוֹנַי עָלוּ.
content.english: And Adonai called out to him: “My children have arisen in My thoughts.

content.hebrew: כֹּה תֹאמַר לָהֶם: רָזֵי תוֹרָתִי יִנְחָֽלוּ.
content.transliteration: Koh tomar lahem: Razē torati yinḥalu.
content.english: Say thus to them: They will inherit the secrets of my Torah.

content.hebrew: יְבָרְרוּ סִיג לֵב, וְצֶֽדֶק יִפְעָֽלוּ."
content.english: They will refine the dross of their heart, and act righteously.”

content.hebrew: וְכָל־הָעָם כְּאֶחָד "נַעֲשֶׂה!" בָּרוּר מִלֵּֽלוּ.
content.english: And the whole people, as one, clearly said: “We will do!”

content.hebrew: צִוָּם הֱיוֹת נְכוֹנִים, בְּאִשָּׁה לְבַל יְגֹאָֽלוּ.
content.transliteration: Tsivvam heyot nekhonim, be’ish’shal leval yeḡoalu.
content.english: He commanded them to be prepared, and not be defiled by [intercourse with] women.

content.hebrew: עֲלוֹת בָּהָר וּנְגֹֽעַ בְּקָצֵֽהוּ – פֶּן יִשָּֽׁלוּ,
content.english: And so that they would not make the mistake of climbing the mountain or touching its edge,

content.hebrew: הִתְיַצֵּב בָּהָר חָמַד אֱלֹהִים, גְּבוּל יַגְבִּֽילוּ.
content.transliteration: Hityats’tsev bahar ḥamad Elohim, gevul yaḡbilu.
content.english: They should make a boundary, [to prevent them from] stepping foot on the mountain that God desires.

content.hebrew: לִפְנֵי סִינַי כָּל־הַר וְגִבְעָה יִשְׁפָּֽלוּ.
content.transliteration: Lifnē har Sinai kol har veḡiv‘a yishpalu.
content.english: Before Sinai, every mountain and hill was made low.

content.hebrew: שָׁקַד מֹשֶׁה בְּחֶבְיוֹן, וְאוֹר פָּנָיו יָהֵֽלּוּ,
content.transliteration: Shaḳad Moshē beḥevyon ‘oz ve’or panav yahellu,
content.english: Moses stood diligently at the concealed place, and the light of his face gleamed;

content.hebrew: לֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר רַעְיוֹנָיו הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ.
content.english: His thoughts were full of understanding, [such that] they were illuminated in light.

content.hebrew: עֶֽשֶׂר דִּבְּרוֹת מִלְּשׁוֹנוֹ נִגְלוּ.
content.english: Ten Utterances were disclosed by His tongue.

content.hebrew: רָאוּ עַם יוי כָּבוֹד, וְנִבְהָֽלוּ.
content.english: Adonai’s people saw His Glory, and they were stunned.

content.hebrew: נָֽעוּ וּמֵרָחוֹק עָמָֽדוּ, כִּי לֹא יָכִֽילוּ.
content.english: They shook, and stood from afar, for they were not able [to stand closer].

content.hebrew: עוֹ[ל] מַלְכוּתוֹ בָּם בְּאַהֲבָה סָבָֽלוּ.
content.english: They lovingly bore the yoke of His kingdom.

content.hebrew: עָנוּ: "דַּבֵּר אַתָּה עִמָּֽנוּ", כִּי לֹא יָכֹֽלוּ
content.english: They called out [to Moses]: “You speak with us,” for they were not able

content.hebrew: שְׁמֽוֹעַ מִפִּי יוי, פֶּן יְאֻכָּֽלוּ.
content.english: To hear from Adonai’s mouth, lest they be consumed.

content.hebrew: עַתָּה בְגָלוּתָם, לְבַד לַיוי יוֹחִֽילוּ,
content.english: Now, in their exile, they put their hope in Adonai alone,

content.hebrew: חזן׃ לְגָאֳלָם מִיַּד צָר – וּבַיוי יִצְדְּקוּ וְיִתְהַלָּֽלוּ.
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Leḡa’olam miyyad tsar – uva’Adonai yitsdeḳu veyit’hallalu.
content.english: Cantor: To redeem them from the enemy—and they are justified and glorified through Adonai.

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (ישעיה מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
